> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking changes.** Do these before you upgrade.
>
> - **Secrets in `config.json`:** The `private_key` and `jupiter_api_key` fields in `config.json` are deprecated and will be removed in a later release. They still work, but SolTrade now logs a warning at startup for each one. Move your wallet key to `SOLTRADE_PRIVATE_KEY` and your Jupiter API key to `SOLTRADE_JUPITER_API_KEY` in `.env`, then delete both fields from `config.json`.
